intro: More than just a bench— Ingrid is your versatile, go-anywhere seat. From dining to décor, our Ingrid bench adds charm and flexibility to your home.

features.title: Classic walnut charm
features.text: Finished in rich walnut, this bench blends effortlessly into your home with a warm, polished appeal.

features.title: Steady in every way
features.text: Thanks to its solid Sheesham wood build, your bench stays sturdy, stylish, and supportive through it all.

features.title: Balanced contrast
features.text: The light brown upholstery contrasts beautifully with the deep walnut frame—bringing modern flair to classic design.

features.title: Soft yet supportive
features.text: With a generously cushioned seat and smooth fabric upholstery, your bench offers both comfort and elegance.

features.title: Sized for real life
features.text: Its slim, space-smart design makes it easy to tuck away or pull up, whether for dinner or a casual conversation.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
